verses.gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਬਿਦਰ ਦੇ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: aaiaa suniaa bidhar dhe bolai dhurajodhan hoi rukhaa|

en.bdb: Hearing that Lord Krishan was served and stayed over at humble Bidar's home, Duryodhan remarked sarcastically.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਅਸਾਡੇ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਗੋਲੇ ਦੇ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਿ ਸੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: ghar asaadde chhadd kai gole dhe ghar jaeh k sukhaa|

en.bdb: Leaving our grand palaces, how much happiness and comfort did you attain in the home of a servant?

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੀਖਮੁ ਦੋਣਾ ਕਰਣ ਤਜਿ ਸਭਾ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਡੇ ਮਾਨੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: bheekham dhonaa karan taj sabhaa seegaar vadde maanukhaa|

en.bdb: You gave up even Bhikhaum, Dohna and Karan who are recognised as great men who are adorned in all courts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਝੁੰਗੀ ਜਾਇ ਵਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੇ ਜੀਅ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: jhu(n)gee jai valaion sabhanaa dhe jeea a(n)dhar dhukhaa|

en.bdb: We have all been anguished to find that you have lived in a hut”.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਜੀ ਸੁਣਿਹੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸਨਮੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: has bolai bhagavaan jee suniho raajaa hoi sanamukhaa|

en.bdb: Then smilingly, Lord Krishan asked the King to come forward and to listen carefully.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਪਦਾ ਦੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: tere bhaau na dhisiee mere naahee apadhaa dhukhaa|

en.bdb: I see no love and devotion in you (and hence I have not come to you).

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਜਿਵੇਹਾ ਬਿਦਰ ਦੇ ਹੋਰੀ ਦੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਚਾਉ ਨ ਚੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhaau jivehaa bidhar dhe horee dhe chit chaau na chukhaa|

en.bdb: No heart I see has even a fraction of the love that Bidar bears in his heart.
The Lord needs loving devotion and nothing else.
